title: Grid
description: Native mobile grid with accessible controls and shared design tokens.

props.description: Square cells (height = width)

props.name: gutter
props.description: Space between the cells, in dp (cells get their own border and radius when set)

props.description: Hairline borders between the cells

props.name: center
props.description: Centers the content of the cells

props.name: direction
props.description: Layout of icon and text in a cell: `vertical` (icon above) or `horizontal` (icon before)

support.notes: Native GridItem supports fullWidth rows in ResponsiveGrid, asChild layout/press composition, and icon/text shortcuts in Grid; it renders actual native content and optional press actions.
